classification.difficultyReason: Multiply by the scale factor. Part b requires matching sides in a rotated triangle using the equal angles.

answer.short: Base: $15\text{ cm}$; vertical side: $20\text{ cm}$; sloping side: $25\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked: $\begin{aligned}\text{Image base}&=6\times2.5\\&=15\text{ cm}\\\text{Image vertical side}&=8\times2.5\\&=20\text{ cm}\\\text{Image sloping side}&=10\times2.5\\&=25\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$

answer.short: Between $44^\circ$ and $57^\circ$: $10.5\text{ cm}$; between $44^\circ$ and $79^\circ$: $9\text{ cm}$; between $57^\circ$ and $79^\circ$: $7.5\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Match corresponding sides using the equal angles.
$\begin{aligned}\text{Image side between }44^\circ\text{ and }57^\circ&=7\times1.5\\&=10.5\text{ cm}\\\text{Image side between }44^\circ\text{ and }79^\circ&=6\times1.5\\&=9\text{ cm}\\\text{Image side between }57^\circ\text{ and }79^\circ&=5\times1.5\\&=7.5\text{ cm}\end{aligned}$
